title: euonymus fortunei f. kewensis
intro: Euonymus fortunei f. kewensis, commonly known as Wintergreen Euonymus, is a variegated cultivar of the Euonymus fortunei species. It is a type of evergreen shrub native to China, prized for its attractive, variegated leaves with yellow and green hues. This plant has been traditionally used to treat various health issues due to its health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, making it useful for reducing stress and promoting relaxation. The bioactive constituents of Wintergreen Euonymus include alkaloids, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its therapeutic actions, such as anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial effects.
